subject: [PATCH 2/4] mm/huge_memory: skip zone device folios in madvise_free_huge_pmd()

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch without any issues or concerns.

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Suggested a more general approach to handling folios, but ultimately gave the patch a positive review.

2026-07-28.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the huge_memory module by skipping zone device folios in madvise_free_huge_pmd(). The current implementation resolves the folio backing a PMD via pmd_folio() and marks it lazyfree without checking for zone device memory. This can lead to incorrect behavior, especially when dealing with device-private THPs. The patch introduces a check to bail out when the folio is a zone device folio, ensuring that these special cases are handled correctly.

reviews.author: Gregory Price
reviews.summary: Acknowledged Lorenzo's suggestion and expressed interest in exploring a more general solution, but ultimately decided to focus on cleaning up zone device handling.
reviews.raw_body:
On Thu, Aug 06, 2026 at 02:59:22PM +0100, Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM) wrote:
> I kinda wish he had some generalised folio handler like:
> 
> 	struct folio_ops {
> 		int (*handle_empty_entry)(void *priv);
> 		int (*handle_normal_folio)(void *priv, struct folio *folio);
> 		int (*handle_softleaf_pte_entry)(void *priv, const pte_t *ptep);
> 		int (*handle_zone_folio)(void *priv, struct folio *folio);
> 		...
> 	};
> 
> Or I don't know an equivalent type of thing, as we keep having these same
> patterns emerge in mm that are duplicated in a million places with slight
> variations... :)
> 
> I wonder if C is expressive enough to get us to something sane though.
> 

This is functionally folio->pgmap except it's not generalized and it
causes us pain :[

I briefly took a forray into moving pgmap to be node-scope, and that
works decently, but first i'm just trying to clena up what i can for
zone device.

Anyway, i get what you're getting at here, and that would be nice.

> > Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>
> > Signed-off-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>
> 
> Anyway LGTM so:
> 
> Reviewed-by: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM) <ljs@kernel.org>
>

many thanks :]

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the huge_memory module by skipping zone device folios in madvise_free_huge_pmd(). The current implementation resolves the folio backing a PMD via pmd_folio() and marks it lazyfree without checking for zone device memory. This can lead to incorrect behavior, especially when dealing with device-private THPs. The patch introduces a check to bail out when the folio is a zone device folio, ensuring that these special cases are handled correctly.
